findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status · Public sink: vadyu_get_video_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status · Public sink: vadyu_get_video_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "vadyu_generate_video_ad" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Generate a commercial AI product video ad from a Shopify/ecommerce product page URL (product_url), a product photo URL (image_url), or a base64 image (image_base64). Supports both API v2/v3 Director Recipes (449 presets such as nyc_luxury, minimal_cinema, dtc_story and editorial_flagship, or custom " → after: "Generate a commercial multi-cut AI video ad (with precision product cutout, live-action 3D studio lighting, golden-hour lifestyle scene, and AI studio voiceover) from a product_url, image_url, or image_base64."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
